bmt-2014-power-22.prompt: A group $G$ *acts* on a set $S$ if each $g\in G$ gives a function $s\mapsto g\cdot s$ on $S$ with $1\cdot s=s$ and $h\cdot(g\cdot s)=(hg)\cdot s$.
